post.title: Artifact Evolution Rail
post.hook: A churn question became a one-pager, a deck, a notebook and an app, all on one scrubbable rail.
post.summary: A Next.js prototype where one idea evolves from terminal session to markdown, deck, notebook and app, each stored as an immutable artifact. The seeded churn run shows the full chain, with a mocked promoter standing in for Claude.
post.writeup:
## What it is
Artifact Evolution is a standalone Next.js prototype for XO. One idea moves through five forms: terminal, markdown one-pager, reveal-style deck, Jupyter notebook and Next.js app. Every form is saved as an immutable artifact, and the whole history can be scrubbed in the browser.

## Why
It sits outside the four XO product repos on purpose, so the feel can be tuned quickly before the pieces are ported into `xo-cowork-api` and `xo-coworker`.

## How it works
Each run lives under `runs/<id>/`. A manifest is the source of truth and artifacts are append-only. Rolling back HEAD only re-points it, so the future is never deleted. The UI has three modes: Work (stage, rail, promote bar), Diff (parent next to child, with carryover, added and dropped chips) and Movie (full-screen, auto-advancing every 4.5s).

A verb heuristic suggests the next form: summarize leads to md, present to deck, explore to notebook, ship to nextjs.

## The seeded run
The run "Ship a churn dashboard" carries one story through every form. Monthly churn rose from 11.4% to 14.2%, and 71% of the increase is starter accounts cancelling in their first 30 days. Day-30 retention is 56.1%, with a target of 68% by Q3. The manifest ends at v06, an auto-promoted dashboard.

## What is fake
- The promoter is a mock, with one seam for an Anthropic-backed version.
- SSE pub/sub is in-process, so it breaks with two replicas.
- There is no auth.
- The notebook renderer is text-only.

## Open questions
The port plan moves storage to Python, the routes to FastAPI and pub/sub to Redis. Whether the heuristic holds up against a real agent runtime is untested.
